1.why: Clean sans-serif typeface with clear label/heading hierarchy and reasonable line spacing in the cards, though the monospace log block is small and tightly wrapped.

2.why: No italics or all-caps body text (only the small 'NORTHSTAR BANK' wordmark) and instructions are single short sentences, but the dark Logs panel is a dense block of wrapped monospace text.

3.why: The layout is a single narrow centred column that would reflow acceptably on a phone, but nothing is demonstrated at mobile width and the long secret/recovery-code strings and log lines already wrap awkwardly at this width.

4.why: Each screen carries one short plain-language sentence such as 'Enter the delivered six-digit code.' and 'Store these codes somewhere safe. Each code can be used once.'

5.why: The recovery-code field shows a format placeholder 'ABCDE-FGHIJ', but the email, phone, verification-code and authenticator-code fields are entirely empty with no example format.

6.why: Progression only ever requires reading a heading plus one short sentence; the only long text is the optional Logs panel, which is not needed to proceed.

7.why: The manual secret, the TOTP code and the eight recovery codes are shown as plain text with no copy button or download option, so they must be transcribed by hand.

8.why: Step 3/4 offers only a 'Manual secret' string; no QR code or scan alternative appears anywhere.

9.why: Fields are standard inputs with visible labels, but there is no evidence of autocomplete attributes (e.g. one-time-code, username) and no password field or password-manager affordance.

10.why: Each card has a bold heading and a prominent blue primary button, but there is no step indicator or progress ('Step 2 of 5'), and on the MFA screen three similarly styled stacked buttons dilute the primary action.

11.why: Most steps ask one thing, but step 3/4 combines 'Generate secret' plus code entry and confirm in one card, and step 6 presents verify, regenerate and log out simultaneously.

12.why: Some outcomes are stated plainly ('Recovery code accepted. Remaining unused codes: 7.', 'MFA enabled — Your authenticator is now enrolled.'), but no screen tells the user what the next step will be.

13.why: Codes can be re-generated ('Regenerate recovery codes') and the secret re-generated, and the recovery field can be retried, but there is no reveal/hide toggle for the displayed secret or codes.

14.why: The only error shown, 'We could not complete that request.', states neither the actual problem nor how to fix it.

15.why: Nothing limits reading time, but the authenticator step imposes an explicit expiry ('expires at 19:55:30') on the code with no visible countdown or extend/refresh option, so entry time is not generous.
